events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Art and Faith

options.text: Ban the sale of [rival] symbols.
Allow them to trade freely in the city.
Adopt the new fashion yourself.

events.text: The markets of [city] are ablaze with a new trend. Traders from a far off land called [rival] have started selling amulets and clothing bearing [religion] <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>symbols of the sacred fire<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>images of the cross<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>symbols of the Star of David<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>depictions of the sun cross<else>religious symbols<end>. The desire for these [rival] wares is threatening to spread across [rival]. What will you do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Christianity Founded

options.text: Ask the apostle to teach you more.
Arrest the apostle.

events.text: A single traveler arrives from the [rival] city of [city]. He calls himself an apostle, a messenger of [religion]. This new religion has separated from the Judaic faith and is quickly gathering followers. The apostle promises paradise to those that follow the word of Christ. At least a few of the court look tempted by his words. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Christianity Founded

options.text: Wait and see how this progresses.
[religion] is the only true path.
Open our borders to the [religion] believers.
This heresy must be met with war.

events.text: Travelers from [city] have been preaching of a man named Jesus Christ, who they call the son of God. These [religion] are teaching that anyone can reach paradise by following the path of Christ. [character] voices his concern that such an openly evangelical religion could threaten the very foundations of [religion]. How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: First Convert

options.text: Invite followers of this miracle worker to settle in [city].
Keep a wary distance from the [religion] [title].
[character] is too easily impressed.

events.text: News has reached [rival] of the new religion of [religion], and its first convert. First hearing of Zoroaster's preaching, [character] had the prophet quickly imprisoned. However, after the prophet healed [character] favorite horse, the [title] released him and accepted the religion as his own. Many of the court are skeptical of such displays of mysticism, but look to your guidance on how to interact with this new religion.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Judaism Founded

options.text: Send the scribe back to learn more of their ways.
This is of no concern to [rival].

events.text: One of your scribes has returned from [city] in [rival], excitedly talking about the practices of [religion]. She fills the court with stories of a god who gifts his followers with words written on stone, and an ancient line of kings hailing back past your own ancestors. Members of your court seem impressed and curious. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Judaism Founded

options.text: Wait and see how this progresses.
[religion] is the only true path.
Open our borders to the [religion] believers.
This heresy must be met with war.

events.text: The people of [city] have begun following the [religion] God, claiming to have his laws handed down to one of their prophets. Their exclusion of other gods and the dedication to their own laws has the Kohanim of [religion] worried about what will happen if these teachings spread. [character] wants to know, will you continue to support the [religion] faith?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Manichaeism Founded

options.text: Make contact with the [religion].
Pay them no heed.

events.text: Tales have reached you of a new religion, [religion], founded in the [rival] city of [city]. One of your spies brings a report on the new Religion of Light. The [religion] follow the teachings of the prophet Mani and believe the world split in two, a spiritual world of light and a material world of darkness. The scholars of your court nod their heads in interest. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Manichaeism Founded

options.text: Wait and see how this progresses.
[religion] is the only true path.
Open our borders to the [religion] believers.
This heresy must be met with war.

events.text: [character] brings news of a new religion that has started in the city of [city]. The people there have founded [religion], following the teachings of the prophet Mani in what he has dubbed the Religion of Light. They believe that the teachings of Mani build on those of Zoroaster, Christ, and the Buddha. Do their ways really supersede those of [religion]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Nation of Faith

options.text: Invite them to visit [city].
Keep the meeting civil, but that is all.
We will not tolerate these foreign ways.

events.text: Some of our Merchants from [city] report meeting a group of strangers on the road. They are people from a far off land called [rival]. While traveling with the strangers to their city of [city], our merchants observe their religious practices of <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>making sacrifices on an open fire<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>singing hymns of worship and praise to their God<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>gathering each week to learn the teachings of their God<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>studying the words of the prophet Mani<else>making sacrifices on an open fire<end>. Intrigued by your own merchants’ stories of [rival], the people of [rival] want to send a [religion] delegation to build a relationship between your people.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Church of Mani

options.text: Send scribes to inquire about these new teachings.
Refuse to give any aid to this new religion.
Decry the findings of this false prophet.

events.text: You have heard of a prophet in [city], preaching a new religion known as the religion of light, [religion]. [character] is said to have heard the voice of his heavenly twin as a child, leaving his father's parish to travel the world. He has now returned, bringing a new knowledge of the divine order and structure of the world. The leader of this new religion has sent a message to your court, asking if you would be interested in listening to the teachings. How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Trouble on the Road

options.text: Send gifts of thanks to [rival].
Praise their bravery and heroism.
Send a cursory message of gratitude.

events.text: While exploring, your scouts are caught in a thunderous downpour. Hopelessly battered and beaten by the storm, they are suddenly approached by strange travelers. After an initially tense standoff, the foreigners provide aid to your scouts, and share that they are from the far off land of [rival]. These saviors explain that they are followers of [religion], which <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>encourages bravery and loyalty to Ahura Mazda<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>practices helping those in need<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>encourages kindness and charitable aid<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>practices consideration for others<else>encourages acts of kindness<end>. They lead your scouts to a nearby ruin where the group shelters together until the storm passes. How will you react to the tale of these kind foreigners?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Zoroastrianism Founded

options.text: [religion] sounds intriguing.
This is of no interest to [rival].

events.text: A merchant, recently returned from [rival], describes the unusual practices of the people of [city]. Following the teachings of the prophet Zoroaster, they have started making sacrifices to a god called Ahura Mazda. Tales of sacred fires, animal sacrifices and a cosmic struggle between gods are soon spreading round the court. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Zoroastrianism Founded

options.text: Wait and see how this progresses.
[religion] is the only true path.
Open our borders to the [religion] believers.
This heresy must be met with war.

events.text: [character] comes to you with news. He has been contacted by a new sect of priests in [city], calling themselves [religion]. The people there have started following the words of the prophet Zoroaster in worshiping the god Ahura Mazda. Their worship practices of sacrifices, song and sacred fires are quickly spreading and [character] urges you to take swift action to ensure the continuation of [religion].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] Zealot

options.text: Ask the zealot to teach you the ways of [religion].
Send him back to [rival] with gifts for their leader.
Take him hostage as leverage against [rival].

events.text: A wandering noble and zealot has reached your lands from the far off nation of [rival]. He is brought before you in chains after scaring people with his prophetic visions, which he claims to be from the [religion]. The court watches this stranger with a mixture of caution and curiosity as you make your judgment.
